description: For sellers: check whether an x402 endpoint is listed in Coinbase's Bazaar and, if not, why. Runs Coinbase's public validator (the indexer's own checks), looks the payout address up in Coinbase's merchant list, and adds the Settle Watch's 30-day availability against Coinbase's 99% bar for featured listings. Returns findings with a fix for each.

method.description: HTTP method of the route (default GET)

url.description: The full https:// URL of your paid endpoint

name: check_listing
title: Why isn't my x402 endpoint in the Bazaar?
